integrity: Standalone exact-rational verifier included, with analytical proof; no independent validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Local Floquet classification only, for the boxed Euler recurrence; the static carrying-capacity benchmark is not the stability criterion of the unstable prey fixed point; equality of Floquet multiplier 1 is unclassified nonlinearly. No global persistence, extinction or positive-cone invariance outside a local neighborhood is claimed. Full priority requires further literature comparison.
title: A counterattack threshold reverses predator invasion over a two-cycle of prey
